subject: Medford Public Schools Funding
overview: School Committee Member Jenny Graham outlined Medford Public Schools' ongoing budget shortfalls, prior reliance on one-time funds, and plans to seek seven million dollars in November to stabilize district operations and invest in staff, facilities, and programs. No formal actions were taken.

items.title: Remarks on Medford Public Schools Budget and November Funding
items.summary: Jenny Graham addressed Medford Public Schools' budget history, explaining how one-time stopgap funding averted severe cuts in the spring and outlining plans to seek seven million dollars in November to stabilize staffing, upgrade technology, adjust high school schedules, increase wages, and address facility repairs.
